50Ten Facilities Services

Good service starts before the first clean.

Our five-step operating approach turns facility expectations into a practical, accountable service plan.

The 50Ten Service System

Structure creates consistency.

The system is intentionally simple: understand the environment, define expectations, turn them into a workable plan, perform the work, then improve from what we learn.

Understand

We learn how the facility operates, what matters most, where prior service has fallen short and what constraints the team needs to work around.

Define

Areas, tasks, frequencies and expectations are made clear so the client and service team share the same reference point.

Plan

The agreed scope becomes a practical service plan rather than a collection of verbal assumptions.

Perform

Prepared teams execute against the documented expectations of the facility.

Verify + Improve

When something needs attention, the goal is to identify it, correct it and use what was learned to strengthen future service.

“Accountability isn't pretending problems never occur. It's having a clear way to respond when they do.”
